title: Just $ave It
description: See what you could be worth if you just saved it
detailedDescription: A compound interest visualiser built to show what small, boring, consistent deposits turn into over time. Built with Next.js and Convex, deployed on Vercel.

title: Quotes that Matter
description: Giving great quotes the attention they deserve
detailedDescription: A quote app built around the idea that the right quote at the right time can change everything. Elegant, distraction-free reading with a curated collection instead of an endless feed.

title: Floating Notes
description: Notes that float on your desktop
detailedDescription: A free, open source alternative to paid menu bar note apps. Transparent always-on-top windows, multi-space support, global shortcuts and URL scheme automation, written in SwiftUI.

title: Spellcheck
description: AI spellchecking in a floating window
detailedDescription: Select text anywhere on your Mac, hit the shortcut, and get a corrected version in a transparent floating window. Auto-copies the selection, diffs the result and highlights what changed.

title: Knot
description: Local-first Markdown Kanban with peer-to-peer sync
detailedDescription: Boards stay as ordinary Markdown files with YAML frontmatter. Cards, immutable revisions and deterministic three-way merges work offline, while Iroh handles peer-to-peer sync between devices. One Tauri app targeting macOS and iOS.

title: RailRadar
description: Track ticket inspectors across Melbourne's rail network
detailedDescription: A crowdsourced map of where ticket inspectors are on the Melbourne metro network, so you know what you are walking into before you tap on. Built with Next.js and deployed on Vercel.

title: Matterstats
description: A reading analytics dashboard for Matter
detailedDescription: Turns your saved Matter reading list into something you can actually reason about: reading streaks, topic breakdowns, time-to-finish estimates and a look back at everything you have already read.

title: degoog-cli
description: A local CLI and MCP server for self-hosted search
detailedDescription: A Rust rewrite of the official Degoog MCP sidecar. Search stays on your server, but scraping, article extraction, chunking and evidence packing all happen locally in a process the MCP client starts and stops. No extra port, container or token to secure.

title: Obsidian Opener
description: Make .md files open in Obsidian, not Xcode
detailedDescription: A tiny menu bar app that registers itself as the handler for Markdown files so double-clicking a .md opens your vault instead of a text editor you never wanted. Set it once, forget it exists.
